WHAT WOULD HAVE TO BE TRUE

at the scale a cell model is meant to be trusted.

A coupled model inherits it; no amount of architecture fixes a weak first layer.
4  SCALE MUST BE CONCEDED, NOT SOLVED. 638 kb/day against 249 Mb is not an engineering gap.
A whole-chromosome physical model is not reachable from here and the honest design
treats chromatin as a boundary condition rather than a simulated object.
